# Runtime reference

<!-- Generated by tools/dev.py docs. Do not edit by hand. -->

Protocol version: **2**. UDP port: **47810**.

Every command requires `protocol: 2`. Packets use little-endian float32 values.

State kind: **3**; forecast kind: **4** (9-float header).

Physical scenes: `au60-solar1000-v1`; migrated scenes: `legacy-sandbox-v1`. See [physical models](physical-model.md).

| Record | Floats |
|---|---:|
| State header | 11 |
| Body | 12 |
| Event | 8 |

At most 1321 physical bodies and eight compact-ejecta views are sent per packet. The event batch shrinks from 64 as needed to stay below 65,507 bytes; remaining events are sent later. Negative body IDs denote non-selectable cloud views.

## Commands

| Command | Fields / meaning |
|---|---|
| `hello` | heartbeat (send twice per second) |
| `bye` | disconnect |
| `add` | type, pos, mode (orbit/launch), drag, mass_mult |
| `predict` | same as add, plus req |
| `belt` | pos, count, mass_mult |
| `remove` | id |
| `supernova` | id |
| `pause` | value (boolean; omit to toggle) |
| `speed` | value (clamped to 0.05–2000) |
| `clear` | no fields |
| `preset` | name |
| `physics` | settings (gravity, epsilon, forecast_limit, escape_distance, collisions, impact_material; partial updates allowed) |
| `conservation` | reset (optional boolean; replace the comparison baseline) |
| `save_scene` | path, camera, request |
| `load_scene` | path, request |
| `checkpoint` | camera, request |
| `restart` | request |
